Two firefighters killed battling blaze at Noida electronic chip factory

A massive fire broke out at an electronic chip manufacturing company in Greater Noida's Ecotech 3 area. During firefighting efforts, a wall and an iron beam collapsed, killing two firefighters and injuring three others. The fire occurred around 3 AM at a company identified as ILGIM, which produces electronic chips. The blaze was significant, requiring extensive efforts to control.
